title: retrophyllum comptonii
intro: Retrophyllum comptonii, commonly known as New Zealand cinnamon or Compton's wood, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of New Zealand. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Retrophyllum comptonii may include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and antiseptic properties, making it a valuable resource for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Retrophyllum comptonii include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
